authority_review.fvg: finite real replay lifecycle coverage passed
authority_review.order_block: finite real replay passed with sparse failed-lifecycle coverage

prohibited_inputs: later displacement or BOS state used to backfill an entity

dependencies.price_grid: integer ticks at the top-level 0.25 tick_size
dependencies.tick_size_consistency: group3, displacement and structure/BOS must all use the exact top-level tick_size

displacement.identity_source: the exact upstream DisplacementState.entity_id and protocol_hash
displacement.qualification_source: the frozen upstream displacement protocol; group3 adds no displacement thresholds

bos.protocol_source: the exact frozen structure/BOS protocol SHA carried by a same-contract, same-tick-grid source envelope
bos.scope_filter: order blocks reject local BOS; continuation is eligible, while opposed requires MSS qualification from the same displacement

clock.decision_update: one group3 update after each newly completed real 5m candle
clock.formation_clock: the completed bar on which all required evidence first coexists
clock.no_backfill: formed_at and confirmed_at are never moved to a source candle, displacement seed or BOS target clock
clock.synthetic: advances the outer market cutoff only; clears unfinished formation/search windows and cannot create, touch, age, mitigate or fail an entity
clock.registered_session_boundary: clears unfinished formation/search windows; already-created same-contract entities remain frozen and do not age at the boundary
clock.unknown_gap_or_contract_change: terminalizes every nonterminal entity with its registered invalidation/failure reason, emits the terminal states, then clears group3 windows

paired_boundary_identity.censored_source: a censored displacement transition must belong to the retained pre-boundary group3 symbol and instrument_id
paired_boundary_identity.contract_change_reset: requires a retained prior group3 identity and a boundary candle whose symbol or instrument_id differs from that identity
paired_boundary_identity.all_other_candle_boundary_reasons: require the boundary candle symbol and instrument_id to equal the retained group3 identity; a foreign candle cannot be treated as a gap, data anomaly, registered closure or synthetic interruption
paired_boundary_identity.unknown_prior_identity: contract_change_reset fails closed when no retained prior group3 identity exists

clock.cold_attach: does not reconstruct an entity unless the retained causal prefix contains every required source bar and upstream transition; otherwise wait for a fresh fully observed setup
clock.exact_retry: same clock plus identical completed-bar and upstream provenance is idempotent
clock.failed_integrated_update: discard the partially advanced observer and resume from the last checkpoint

processing_order: validate the completed 5m candle, contract, tick grid and boundary provenance
admit the same candle to the frozen displacement and structure/BOS reducers
apply the candle once to FVG and order-block entities created before this candle, using terminal priority before mitigation
form new FVG and order-block entities from evidence first complete at this candle
emit one immutable current snapshot and its ordered lifecycle transitions

formation_window.continuity: three consecutive real_completed 5m candles from the same symbol, instrument_id and uninterrupted semantic epoch

geometry.equality: touching outer candles do not form an FVG
geometry.frozen: direction, bounds, edges, midpoint, source candle identities, formation ATR and formation-time qualification never change

qualification.raw: every strict three-bar geometry is created and remains visible even without displacement evidence
qualification.displacement_linked: at c3 formation only: one active same-direction displacement admits c2 and has active_at <= c3.end
qualification.no_backfill: a raw gap is never upgraded when a displacement activates after c3
qualification.formation_atr: mean positive true range of at most 14 real 5m bars completed before c3; c3 is excluded and tick_size is the positive fallback
qualification.strength: compatibility-only zero value; width_atr remains the descriptive geometry and is not a trade-quality score

qualified_displacement.evaluation_clock: after c3 has been admitted to the upstream displacement reducer
qualified_displacement.central_bar_membership: c2.candle_id must be proven as an admitted candle in the same displacement episode; a clock interval alone is insufficient
qualified_displacement.activation_clock: displacement.active_at <= c3.end; activation on c3 is allowed
qualified_displacement.late_activation: an episode that becomes active after c3 cannot qualify or backfill the earlier gap

identity_fields: qualification is deliberately excluded from identity

later_bar_rules.eligibility: only a real_completed 5m candle with end strictly after confirmed_at
later_bar_rules.near_edge_equality: a wick that only equals the near edge does not enter the gap and leaves it open
later_bar_rules.far_edge_equality: a wick or close that equals the far edge is mitigated, not invalidated
later_bar_rules.partial_revisions: retain the maximum causal penetration fraction and the first partial_at clock without moving any frozen boundary

formation.required_bos: one newly observed same-direction confirmed 5m continuation BOS, or opposed BOS qualified as MSS by this exact displacement; local BOS is rejected
formation.break_membership: bos.break_bar_id must be one of the displacement admitted_candle_ids
formation.displacement_state_clock: the displacement episode must still be active after the BOS resolution candle is admitted
formation.missing_or_ambiguous_evidence: emit no order-block entity and no failed placeholder

source_search.window: the real completed 5m candle immediately before the displacement seed is mandatory; retained history is bounded at 64 but a full 64-bar prefix is not a qualification condition
source_search.future_expansion: the frozen window is never enlarged after the seed
source_search.long_displacement_candidate: the seed-adjacent candle must have close_ticks < open_ticks
source_search.short_displacement_candidate: the seed-adjacent candle must have close_ticks > open_ticks
source_search.cluster_extension: scan backward only through immediately contiguous same-contract reverse or doji candles; stop at the first directional, missing or synthetic interruption
source_search.doji: allowed only while extending behind the strict seed-adjacent reverse anchor
source_search.selection: the strict seed-adjacent reverse candle plus its contiguous reverse/doji predecessor cluster
source_search.frozen_zone: freeze every anchor candle identity, cluster full low/high bounds, cluster body bounds and full-range midpoint

geometry.body_bounds: minimum body low through maximum body high across the frozen cluster
geometry.frozen: anchor candle identities, full-range bounds, body bounds, midpoint, displacement identity, BOS identity and all source clocks never change

association.direction: order block, displacement and BOS directions must match
association.displacement: store exact entity_id, protocol_hash, seed_candle_id, started_at, active_at and prefix_commitment
association.bos: store exact protocol_hash, bos_id, target_swing_id, source_structure_id, scope and resolved_at
association.uniqueness: exactly one displacement episode, one BOS generation and one selected source candle must satisfy the frozen relation

later_bar_rules.eligibility: only a real_completed 5m candle with end strictly after created_at
later_bar_rules.distal_edge_equality: a close equal to the distal edge is not failure; an intersecting bar is mitigated

capacity.state_limit_scope: each top-level maximum covers the complete retained realtime collection, including live and terminal states
capacity.terminal_state_retention: a mitigated, invalidated, expired or failed entity stays in the tracker for this many completed native bars, counting the bar that made it terminal, then is compacted at the start of the next completed native bar; the terminal transition is delivered in the output of its own bar and the event log owns the fact. Registered under v1.3 as zone_terminal_state_retention, exactly as the Group 5 context and liquidity terminal-state retentions are
capacity.terminal_eviction: only a terminal entity already exposed in an earlier successful observation may be removed, oldest terminal clock then identity first; with the retention above this guard is reached only when live state alone fills the maximum
capacity.same_bar_terminal_exposure: new terminal transitions remain visible through the successful observation that produced them
capacity.exhaustion: if compaction cannot admit the new entity, reject the entire completed-bar update and fail closed without partial clock, lifecycle or history mutation

common: stable entity identity and protocol identity
formed_at, confirmed_at, last_updated_at and terminal clock
fvg_specific: near_edge, far_edge, width_ticks and maximum penetration fraction
c1, c2 and c3 candle identities
order_block_specific: ordered anchor candle identities, strict seed-adjacent body direction, full bounds and body bounds
source BOS identity, target swing, scope and resolution clock
required_output.consumers: typed observation, event memory, brain and visualization consume these fields directly; hard-boundary terminal transitions are isolated in typed observation boundary fields and replay rows rather than inserted into the new epoch's ordinary event memory; no consumer reconstructs geometry from prose or legacy impulse proxies

change_control.not_strategy_logic: this protocol describes causal location entities and does not authorize entry, stop, target, belief weight or action utility changes
change_control.semantic_change: any geometry operator, search-window length, source gate, lifecycle rule, priority, boundary behavior or capacity change requires a new protocol version
change_control.validation_before_freeze: one implementation, one static self-review, one unified synthetic/boundary/causal suite, one finite real OHLCV replay, one stratified blind review and at most one concept-level repair
